description: This file declares the MainThread class and its factory, which implement the IMainThread interface for managing a main thread that handles task queuing and client registration in a media server context. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: MainThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing singleton instances of MainThread, implementing thread-safe access.

classes.name: MainThread
classes.description: Implements the IMainThread interface, managing client registration, task queuing, and execution within a dedicated thread.

methods.name: MainThreadFactory::getMainThread
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton MainThread instance.

methods.name: MainThread::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client and returns its client ID.

methods.name: MainThread::unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client based on its client ID.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task for a specific client.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Enqueues a task and waits for its completion.

methods.name: MainThread::mainThreadLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in a separate thread to process queued tasks.

methods.name: MainThread::waitForTask
methods.description: Blocks until a task is available in the queue and returns it.
